text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Seriouslyyy!! And here I was totally 
feelin' like I'd win, too~~!!
choice_data_list: There was definitely a good response.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Riiight~~?! Up until midway, that is!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, well, stuff like this happens!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tbh, going all out was super fun! We're 
definitely gonna win next time!
choice_data_list:
Next time, let's live up to the crowd's 
expectations!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For now, let's do a post-event party! If 
any of my stans are crying, I gotta hype 
'em up!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We'll hype 'em up and fire 'em up, then 
blow the roof off in the next race~~!!

Even though she spun her wheels a little, 
Daitaku Helios ran through with everything 
she had. She had grown just a little bit 
tougher.
